description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Awoken Water], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Mimicry Stunt Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Awoken Water
description.text: Water abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Mimicry Stunt Mode
description.text: Grants [Buff Water 10% (15s)] to all allies after three Water abilities are used by other allies, removed after triggering three times, grants [Triplecast Water 1] and [Water Ability +30% Boost 1] to the user when removed
